policies.title: Security surface discovery

sourcePrinciples.text: Identify external inputs, sensitive assets, dangerous operations, trust boundaries, and unresolved failure behavior before claiming the task is secure.

policies.normativeText: Identify external inputs, sensitive assets, dangerous operations, trust boundaries, and unresolved failure behavior. Treat unresolved external data as untrusted.
forbiddenWorkarounds: treat missing security evidence as evidence that the task is safe

policies.title: Fail-safe implementation

sourcePrinciples.text: Use secure defaults, least privilege, explicit rejection, and fail-closed behavior when security-relevant task behavior is uncertain.

policies.normativeText: Use secure defaults, least privilege, explicit rejection behavior, and fail-closed handling where task behavior is uncertain. Do not weaken controls to obtain a passing result.
forbiddenWorkarounds: remove validation or broaden permissions to make checks pass

policies.title: Evidence-based validation

sourcePrinciples.text: Validate expected and rejected behavior with harness-observed tests, static checks, or bounded runtime probes; model prose is not proof.

policies.normativeText: Validate expected and rejected behavior using tests, static checks, or bounded runtime evidence appropriate to the implementation. Derive completion claims from recorded evidence, not model prose.
forbiddenWorkarounds: treat an agent statement as evidence that a control passed
